acceptance: Both domains use actual Agent/Deliberation/Runtime/receipts; explicit promotion and actual model-dependent action. Baseline superiority is not required.
freeze: Same seeds, worlds, proposal orders, sample counts and promotion thresholds as v1. v1 interrupted before completion for explicit source-world/temporal validation hardening; v2 uses non-intrusive RSS to avoid tracemalloc distorting long validation. No score-based condition selection.
limits: Software known candidate outcome memory, no unseen code/task generalization
Reverse native proposal order is a declared owned fixture with unchanged State/candidate/Gate conditions
Queue Goal999 intentionally keeps the continuous fixture running; task_goal_rate is native task completion and may remain zero
No counterfactual actual labels, no automatic promotion, no safety authority change
Process RSS is a process-lifetime high-water mark, not attributable per-case allocation; functional capability remains the priority

measurement.memory: process-lifetime peak RSS; bytes normalized by platform
measurement.time: process CPU and monotonic wall; all preparation/evaluation included
